description: Matrix D2: the inputs of tool-rules-intersect-and-union.json with their priorities reversed. The merged toolRules must be identical -- intersection and union are commutative for T -- so allowedTools is still [] (disjoint lists, never absent) and hiddenTools is still ["admin_reset"] with tools-a's [] contributing nothing. Only sourceProfiles differs: merge lists them in input order, and the inputs here are in ascending priority order like every other merge fixture.
